mission: Fix two P1 blockers that prevent copy trading from working. T1: DW-B17-LEADER-01 — WireLeaderAccount in TradeCopierAddOn.cs finds Instrument ComboBox instead of Account ComboBox. T2: DW-B18-ACCOUNTS-01 — follower ListBox ScrollViewer trap renders only 4 items. T3: DW-B18-CANCEL-01 — CancelPendingEntries skips Initialized follower orders; SendCopy uses DateTime.MaxValue causing GTC-stuck sim orders. T4 (deferred): DW-B17-SYNC-01 copy ON/OFF sync. T5 (deferred): DW-B17-ACCOUNT-NAME-01 broker suffix strip.
conflict_note: B17 owns TradeCopierPanel.cs exclusively. B18 T1+T2+T3 have zero file overlap with B17 — safe to run in parallel. B18 T4 (deferred) touches TradeCopierPanel.cs — MUST wait for B17 to close.

known_tasks.title: WireLeaderAccount: replace FindVisualChild<ComboBox> with FindAccountComboBox (walks all, picks Account)
known_tasks.root_cause: FindVisualChild<ComboBox> DFS first-match returns Instrument ComboBox. SelectedItem as Account = null. _leaderAccount stays null. OnApplyRule exits with 'No leader' regardless of ChartTrader selection.
known_tasks.fix: Add private static ComboBox FindAccountComboBox(DependencyObject parent) that walks all ComboBoxes and returns first where SelectedItem is NinjaTrader.Cbi.Account. Replace FindVisualChild<ComboBox>(chartTrader) call in WireLeaderAccount with FindAccountComboBox(chartTrader). FindVisualChildByName<T> at L515 is a safe template for the new helper.

known_tasks.title: TradeCopierWindow follower ListBox: remove outer ScrollViewer, set fixed Height
known_tasks.root_cause: BuildRuleRow and BuildDynamicRuleRow wrap followerLb (ListBox) in ScrollViewer { MaxHeight=80 }. VirtualizingStackPanel sees infinite height from ScrollViewer, renders only 4 items (80px / ~22px = 4 rows). All accounts are bound but not rendered. Scroll does not work.
known_tasks.fix: Remove the outer ScrollViewer in both BuildRuleRow and BuildDynamicRuleRow. Set followerLb.Height = 100 (fixed, not MaxHeight). Place followerLb directly in the Grid column. The ListBox's own internal ScrollViewer handles scrolling. Apply identically to both methods.
